body: BLOCK at exact 9881e06c7211ae5ef5505ab4edc6b1a9b2b852d9. The five amended source descriptions are correct. At candidate base b73692f, cost.scala documents SemanticDistance as [0,1], while public SemanticDistance.of/fromTable/fromTableOrAbstain wrap arbitrary Double as Estimate.observed; candidates.scala then sorts and publishes it. Sections 2/2.1 and M1 would admit finite -1.0 or 2.0. The successor must require each typed score channel to declare and enforce its lawful domain before sort/take, and add finite out-of-range refusal controls for the semantic channel, while retaining the valid source corrections. No vocabulary, authorization, or landing is inferred.
